global.title: Xona launches six satellites to begin commercial navigation service
global.summary: WASHINGTON — Xona Space Systems launched six satellites on a SpaceX rideshare mission Oct. 20, a deployment that will allow the California startup to begin demonstrating its positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) technology as a multi-satellite system.

global.title: AnySignal to Deliver Space-to-Earth Communications for Three Reflect Orbital Missions
global.summary: LOS ANGELES — October 20, 2026 AnySignal , a leading provider of software-defined radios and space-based networking, today announced an agreement with Reflect Orbital to deliver space-to-earth communications for Reflect Orbital’s inaugural satellite and two subsequent missions. global.title: Sound decisions will enable U.S. crewed lunar landings
global.summary: NASA has successfully led off the Artemis human lunar program with the Artemis 1 test flight and the exciting Artemis 2 crewed flight around the moon. These missions demonstrated the United States’ capability to conduct human deep space exploration with the highly proven Space Launch System (SLS) and Orion crew vehicle. It is essential to continue an accelerated mission cadence to reduce risk and validate increasing capabilities on a pace to safely land astronauts on the moon as soon as possible
